answer: We define a protocol where dynamic opportunity-cost bonds operate as a cryptoeconomic garden of locked collateral, tethering identity generation to quadratic capital requirements via an entropy beacon. Mapping subgame-perfect punishment matrices to Byzantine behavior proves that the expected utility of Sybil multiplication is strictly negative, as marginal node costs exceed rewards filtered through a zero-knowledge verifiable delay pulse. This enforces a robust Nash equilibrium where adversarial deviation is disincentivized by deterministic depletion of staked liquidity.
